hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/plans" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; d=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); for f in *.md; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in [0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-*) ;; *) t="$d-$f"; if [ -e "$t" ]; then b="${t%.md}"; i=2; while [ -e "$b-$i.md" ]; do i=$((i+1)); done; t="$b-$i.md"; echo "plans hook: collision on $d-$f, renamed to $t" >&2; fi; mv -n "$f" "$t" ;; esac; done
